title: ComputeEscrow slash-redistribution integration
predecessor_note: The CMP-1.5.10 branch independently carried the same CMP-1.5.9 documentation qualification fix before its own exact-head run; the configured base_head is therefore an earlier executable-equivalent predecessor head, while CMP-1.5.9 formal qualification completed on 4845679d1ca41152e3299870af2ed3b8e9e06c1e.
implementation_summary: freeze the canonical ComputeEscrow entitlement endpoint and runtime code hash in the verifier-dispute slash recipient resolver
require the explicit objective verifier-error dispute ground before harmed-payer resolution
derive harmed payer only from canonical finalized ComputeEscrow/dispute state
prove slash-recipient resolution is read-only with respect to payer Vault balance, accounting and refund obligations
retain CMP-1.5 collateral as the only slash-value source
reconcile the CMP-1.2 closeout ledger so the repository stake/slash dependency is satisfied without claiming live deployment
requirements_satisfied: canonical entitlement endpoint and runtime code hash frozen
generic adverse payer-win dispute cannot resolve slash recipient
canonical harmed payer reconstructed from escrow entitlement state
recipient resolution leaves payer escrow accounting unchanged
slash value originates only from separately backed CMP-1.5 collateral
payer deposits never become stake or slash backing

level_2.milestone: cross-phase ComputeEscrow payer accounting to CMP-1.5 collateral redistribution

security_results: generic adverse dispute rejected as slash-recipient source
canonical harmed-payer resolution leaves payer escrow balance and accounting unchanged
payer refund obligation identity and state remain unchanged by slash-recipient resolution
collateral distribution authority remains separate from ComputeEscrow settlement/refund authority
limitations: no live deployment, Registry publication or live slash transaction claim
live operational stake slashing remains blocked pending testnet deployment evidence
repository-wide Level 3 qualification remains deferred to CMP-1.5.13
